public class FilterInputGroupTypeahead extends BaseFilterInputGroup<FilterInputGroupTypeahead> implements Attachable, Expandable<HTMLElement, FilterInputGroupTypeahead>, Typeahead<FilterInputGroupTypeahead>
A filter input with typeahead/autocomplete support. Combines a filter input (with a label group) with an attached Menu to provide autocomplete behavior driven by a RefreshStrategy.
See Also:
  • https://www.patternfly.org/components/text-input-group#with-filters
